intro: Around 80% of Turkmenistan is covered by the Karakum desert.

chapters.title: Desert and canal
text: The Karakum ('black sand') covers most of the land. The Karakum Canal, one of the longest irrigation canals in the world, carries water from the Amu Darya across the desert.
The Kopet Dag mountains form the border with Iran, and the Caspian Sea lies to the west.

chapters.title: The Door to Hell
text: The Darvaza gas crater has been burning since 1971, when a drilling accident released natural gas.
